# SVG diagram craft

Docs diagrams are hand-laid, professional SVGs, not Mermaid. Each one is a
small source file built with `scripts/diagram-kit.mjs`, so it stays on brand,
works in light and dark themes, and can be reviewed and changed like code.

## 1. Earn its place

Draw a diagram only for branching, a loop, a pipeline with more than one path,
a system with several parts, or a comparison the reader must see at a glance.
A straight list of steps is a numbered list, not a diagram.

## 2. Show the real mechanism

Use the real names from the doc: the actual steps, agents, gates, screens,
numbers. Every node and label must be something the surrounding text names.
If the diagram adds nothing a list would not, delete it.

## 3. Design system

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Kinds (colour = meaning) | `step` indigo: our system or an action · `good` emerald: outcome, pass · `risk` amber: gate, decision, partial · `stop` rose: fail, never-do · `live` sky: live state, AI, data, external · `plain` neutral: context |
| Cards | `node`: eyebrow (e.g. STEP 1, PHASE 2, an owner), title (≤ 4 words), sub (≤ 8 words). Width 160–240. |
| Decisions | `decision`: a question ending in "?", ≤ 3 words; every exit edge labelled |
| Edges | Always labelled with the verb or condition (≤ 3 words). Happy path solid; loops and fallbacks `dashed`; colour the edge with the kind of where it leads when that carries meaning |
| Groups | `group` for phases, lanes, repos or systems; title in caps, optional sub |
| Spacing | 8px grid. Gap ≥ 64px between cards joined by a labelled edge, ≥ 32px otherwise. Groups pad their cards by 24px and leave 48px at the top for the title |
| Size | Content width 960–1120. One idea per diagram; split past ~12 cards |
| Header | `title` states the subject; `subtitle` states the claim in one line |
| Legend | List only the kinds used, named for what they mean here |
| Text | Sentence case. No jargon the doc hasn't introduced. Never shrink text to fit; resize the card |

## 4. Build one

```js
// docs/diagrams/src/03-feature-map.mjs
import { diagram, node, decision, edge, group, note, quadrant } from '../../../scripts/diagram-kit.mjs';

export default diagram({
  title: 'Feature map',
  subtitle: 'Ten features across three phases, with two gates',
  width: 1080, height: 420,              // content area, in px
  legend: [{ kind: 'step', label: 'Feature' }, { kind: 'risk', label: 'Gate' }],
  items: [
    group({ x: 0, y: 0, w: 320, h: 420, title: 'Phase 1', sub: 'Free core' }),
    node({ id: 'f1', x: 24, y: 56, w: 272, eyebrow: 'F1', title: 'Sub-topic practice', sub: 'Three levels per moment' }),
    decision({ id: 'g1', x: 360, y: 160, title: 'AI matches human?' }),
    edge({ from: 'f1', to: 'g1', label: 'scored blind' }),
    edge({ from: 'g1', to: 'f1', label: 'no: fix rubrics', kind: 'stop', dashed: true,
           fromSide: 'bottom', toSide: 'bottom', via: [[444, 380], [160, 380]] }),
  ],
});
```

API (all coordinates in the content area, top-left origin):

- `node({ id, x, y, w, h?, kind?, eyebrow?, title, sub?, badge?, align?: 'center' })`; height is automatic when omitted.
- `decision({ id, x, y, w?=168, h?=104, kind?='risk', title })`.
- `edge({ from, to, label?, kind?, dashed?, fromSide?, toSide?, via?: [[x,y],…], labelAt?, labelXY? })`.
  Sides are `left|right|top|bottom`; routes are orthogonal with rounded bends. Use `via` for loops.
- `group({ x, y, w, h, kind?, title, sub? })`, drawn behind everything.
- `note({ x, y, w?, text, kind?, strong? })` for a short annotation.
- `quadrant({ x, y, w, h, xAxis: [low, high], yAxis: [low, high], quadrants: [tl, tr, bl, br] as { label, kind? }, points: [{ x: 0–1, y: 0–1, label, kind?, highlight?, labelSide? }] })`.

The kit refuses unknown kinds, unknown edge ends and cards outside the content area.

## 5. Build, look, fix

1. `npm run diagrams` writes `docs/diagrams/<name>.svg`.
2. `node scripts/build-diagrams.mjs <name> --preview <scratch-dir>` writes light
   and dark PNGs (needs Playwright; set `PLAYWRIGHT_DIR`). **Open both PNGs and
   look.** Fix overlaps, cramped labels, crossing edges, uneven spacing and
   orphan whitespace, then rebuild. Repeat until it reads at a glance.
3. Embed it where the old diagram or widget was:

   ```markdown
   ![Practice loop: answer, see rubric points, take one fix, retry until ready](diagrams/01-practice-loop.svg)
   *One moment is practised until it is ready at the candidate's level.*
   ```

   Alt text says what the diagram shows in one sentence; the italic caption
   directly under it states its claim in 5–12 words.

## 6. Review checklist

- [ ] Earns its place; every label comes from the doc.
- [ ] Every edge labelled; every decision exit labelled.
- [ ] Kinds used for meaning only; legend lists exactly the kinds used.
- [ ] No overlapping text, no edge crossing a card, no label covering an arrow.
- [ ] Reads in both the light and dark previews.
- [ ] Source in `docs/diagrams/src/`, SVG rebuilt, alt text and caption present.
